description: This file defines the CartService class, which encapsulates business logic related to shopping cart operations such as adding, retrieving, updating, and removing items in a user's cart. It interacts with repository classes for data persistence and applies rules such as stock validation and total calculations.

classes.name: CartService
classes.description: Service class managing business logic for shopping cart operations including adding, retrieving, updating, and removing cart items.

methods.name: int add_item(self, customer_id: int, product_id: int, quantity: int, options: dict)
methods.description: Adds a product to the cart after validating product existence and stock, updating existing entries if present.

methods.name: CartResponse get_cart(self, customer_id: int)
methods.description: Retrieves the cart items for a customer and calculates totals such as subtotal, shipping, tax, and total.

methods.name: None update_item(self, cart_id: int, quantity: int, customer_id: int)
methods.description: Updates the quantity of an existing cart item.

methods.name: None remove_item(self, cart_id: int, customer_id: int)
methods.description: Removes an item from the cart.

methods.name: None clear_cart(self, customer_id: int)
methods.description: Clears all items from the customer's cart.

ctags.name: add_item
ctags.pattern: /^    def add_item(self, customer_id: int, product_id: int, quantity: int, options: dict) -> int:$/
ctags.signature: (self, customer_id: int, product_id: int, quantity: int, options: dict)

ctags.name: remove_item
ctags.pattern: /^    def remove_item(self, cart_id: int, customer_id: int) -> None:$/

ctags.name: update_item
ctags.pattern: /^    def update_item(self, cart_id: int, quantity: int, customer_id: int) -> None:$/
ctags.signature: (self, cart_id: int, quantity: int, customer_id: int)
